tools.name: calculators__uk-business-days
tools.description: Is a date a UK business day; add or subtract N business days; count business days between dates. Uses official bank holidays per nation. Free within the daily allowance, then $0.001 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: calculators__postcode-distance
tools.description: Straight-line distance (km and miles) and compass bearing between two UK postcodes. Free within the daily allowance, then $0.002 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: calculators__currency-convert
tools.description: Convert between ~30 currencies at the ECB reference rate for today or any date in the last 90 days. Free within the daily allowance, then $0.001 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: time__convert
tools.description: Convert a wall-clock time from one IANA zone to another; says when it is ambiguous (clocks go back) or never happens (clocks go forward). Free within the daily allowance, then $0.001 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: time__now
tools.description: Local time, UTC, offset, abbreviation, DST flag, weekday and ISO week for a zone. Free within the daily allowance, then $0.001 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: time__zone-info
tools.description: Offset, abbreviation and DST at a moment, plus the next clock change, for an IANA zone. Free within the daily allowance, then $0.001 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: time__business-days
tools.description: Count business days between two dates, or add business days to a date, skipping weekends and the country's public holidays. Free within the daily allowance, then $0.001 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: time__signed
tools.description: Server UTC time and a request id. The cheapest paid endpoint: use it to test an x402 payment end to end. Costs $0.001 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: uk-bank-holidays__all
tools.description: Every published UK bank holiday by division. Free within the daily allowance, then $0.001 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: uk-bank-holidays__england-and-wales
tools.description: Bank holidays in England and Wales. Free within the daily allowance, then $0.001 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: uk-bank-holidays__scotland
tools.description: Bank holidays in Scotland. Free within the daily allowance, then $0.001 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: uk-bank-holidays__northern-ireland
tools.description: Bank holidays in Northern Ireland. Free within the daily allowance, then $0.001 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: vat__rates
tools.description: Standard, reduced and super-reduced VAT rates for one country or all of EU27 + UK, with the date they were checked. Free within the daily allowance, then $0.001 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: vat__calculate
tools.description: Net to gross or gross to net at a given rate, or at a country's standard rate. Free within the daily allowance, then $0.001 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: vat__validate-format
tools.description: Country format and check digit for UK (GB/XI) and EU VAT numbers. Does not confirm registration. Free within the daily allowance, then $0.001 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: holidays__year
tools.description: Official public holidays for a country (or region provider, e.g. Germany/Bavaria) in a year. Free within the daily allowance, then $0.001 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: holidays__check
tools.description: Is a date a public holiday or business day in a country; add N business days; next business day. Free within the daily allowance, then $0.001 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: holidays__countries
tools.description: Every country and regional provider supported. Free within the daily allowance, then $0.0005 USDC per call via x402.
